clubs.name: Cheltenham & County Harriers
clubs.description: The town's long-established athletics and running club, founded in 1880, training from Prince of Wales Stadium.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Running and Walking Club
clubs.description: An inclusive running and walking club for all abilities, from Couch to 5k up to sub-18-minute 5k runners.

clubs.name: CLC Striders
clubs.description: An inclusive and competitive running club training from the CLC Health & Fitness Centre.

clubs.name: Almost Athletes
clubs.description: Cheltenham's largest running club, for runners of all abilities.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Foxes
clubs.description: A YouRun social running community with a weekly conversational-paced evening run from The Fox at Dowdeswell, Thursdays at 6:30pm, plus occasional weekend runs and hikes. All abilities welcome.
clubs.address: The Fox at Dowdeswell, GL54 4HG

clubs.name: Cheltenham Cricket Club
clubs.description: Based at The Victoria Ground in Fairview, the club has a rich history and an ambitious vision for the future. It fields four senior men's teams, three women's teams, and a junior set-up for boys and girls aged 4 to 19.
clubs.address: The Victoria Ground, Princes Street, Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, GL52 6BE

clubs.name: Cheltenham North Rugby Club
clubs.description: Founded in 1905 and based in Stoke Orchard, with teams from under 7s to senior level.
clubs.address: Stoke Orchard Road, Bishops Cleeve, Cheltenham GL52 7DG

clubs.name: Cheltenham Rugby Club
clubs.description: Founded in 1889 and based at Newlands Park since 2015 in purpose-built facilities, with teams from under 4s to veterans.
clubs.address: Newlands Park Sports & Social Venue, Southam Lane, Southam, Cheltenham, GL52 3PE

clubs.name: Cheltenham Saracens Rugby
clubs.address: King George V Playing Field, Brooklyn Road, Cheltenham

clubs.name: Cheltenham Archers
clubs.description: Founded in 1857 and a member of Archery GB, the club offers beginners' courses, memberships and several annual tournaments.
clubs.address: Oakleaf Field, Southam Lane, Cheltenham GL50 4SH

clubs.name: Cheltenham Boxing Academy
clubs.description: Members include people of all ages, genders and professions, with sessions for children as well as adults.
clubs.address: Unit 4C, King Alfred Way, Battledown Industrial Estate, Cheltenham, GL52 6QP

clubs.name: Cheltenham Croquet Club
clubs.description: One of the largest and oldest croquet clubs in Britain, with 10 full-size lawns, and a member of the South West Federation of Croquet Clubs and Croquet England.
clubs.address: Old Bath Road, Cheltenham, Gloucestershire GL53 7DF

clubs.name: Cheltenham Triathlon Club
clubs.description: A club for experienced and aspiring triathletes, with regular coached swim and run sessions and an uncoached Sunday morning bike ride. It is an adult club, and places can be limited by swim capacity. The club also runs Tri in the Park, a family-friendly super-sprint triathlon in Pittville Park.

clubs.name: Cheltenham & County Cycling Club
clubs.description: A road, mountain bike and gravel club with around 300 members, running its own road race, time trial series, hill climb series and cyclocross races.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Cycling Touring Club (CTC)
clubs.description: A friendly, relaxed club affiliated to Cycling UK, with group rides across the week for all riders.

clubs.name: Woodmancote Wheelers
clubs.description: A social road cycling club based just north of Cheltenham, with Classic and faster-paced Velo group rides.

clubs.name: Boulders Cheltenham
clubs.description: An indoor bouldering centre in Cheltenham itself, for first-timers through to experienced climbers.

clubs.name: British Mountaineering Council: Club Finder
clubs.description: For outdoor climbing and mountaineering clubs across Gloucestershire and the wider region.

clubs.name: All Star Passion
clubs.description: Competitive cheerleading in Cheltenham with beginner, competition and after-school clubs available.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Rambling Club
clubs.description: An independent local walking club with walks of 4 to 14 miles.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Spa Walkers
clubs.description: Cheltenham's local group of the Ramblers, Britain's walking charity.

clubs.name: Cotswold Voluntary Wardens: Guided Walks
clubs.description: Free, volunteer-led guided walks across the Cotswolds National Landscape on Cheltenham's doorstep.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Camera Club
clubs.description: Founded in 1865, the club is the largest photo club in Gloucestershire, with members ranging from novices to international award winners.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Film Society
clubs.description: Founded in 1945 and now over 500 members strong, showing subtitled and independent films between September and April at the Bacon Theatre in Dean Close School.
clubs.address: Hatherley Road, Cheltenham GL51 6EP

clubs.name: Cheltenham Bridge Club
clubs.description: Runs duplicate bridge sessions at its Tivoli Road club and online on weekdays, with beginner and intermediate courses for new players.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Chess Club
clubs.description: Meets from 7.30pm every Tuesday and Thursday evening.
clubs.address: Victory Club, Lypiatt Road, Cheltenham GL50 2SY

clubs.name: Cheltenham Silver Band
clubs.description: A community brass band that rehearses at St Barnabas Church in Orchard Way. Interested players can join the mailing list or get in touch through the website.
clubs.address: St Barnabas Church, 33 Orchard Way, Cheltenham GL51 7JY

clubs.name: Cheltenham & District Allotment Holders' Association
clubs.description: Founded in 1976, the association represents allotment gardeners, works with the council on tenancy terms, rents and site upkeep, and offers members support and advice.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Local History Society
clubs.description: Founded in 1982, a registered charity running morning and evening talks, walks, visits and local history afternoons, with free online journal articles, newspapers and directories.

clubs.name: Leckhampton Local History Society
clubs.description: Founded in 1992, the society holds talks most months except over the summer, and organises outings, field trips and research projects for members.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Civic Society
clubs.description: A non-political, member-funded charity with a constitution dating from 1963, encouraging high standards of design for buildings and public spaces, conservation of the town's heritage, and discussion of the urban environment.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Rotary Club
clubs.description: Part of a Rotary tradition of more than 100 years, supporting local and international charities and good causes.

clubs.name: Cheltenham Probus
clubs.description: Founded in May 1972, the Probus Club of Cheltenham meets every week for social contact and to hear speakers on a variety of topics.
clubs.address: Cheltenham Whaddon Bowls Club, Whaddon Road, Cheltenham, Gloucestershire, GL52 5NA

clubs.name: Cheltenham Regency Probus Club
clubs.description: Founded in 1976, the club gives retired men and women from professional and business backgrounds regular meetings with like-minded people, with an emphasis on socialising and making new friends.

clubs.name: Art Craft Workshop
clubs.description: Termly art and pottery classes in Montpellier: pottery and ceramics, pottery throwing, sketching and drawing, and life drawing with a model. Courses suit beginners and more experienced students, and the pottery classes are popular, so book early.
clubs.address: 14 Lansdown Crescent Lane, Montpellier, Cheltenham, GL50 2LD

clubs.name: Cheltenham Open Studios
clubs.description: A not-for-profit association run by artists for artists. What began as a biennial Open Studios event has grown into a year-round community, connecting artists, audiences and creative spaces across Cheltenham and the surrounding area.

clubs.name: Cheltenham School of Fine Art
clubs.description: Studio art classes in painting and drawing, including life, portrait, landscape and still life, plus evening classes, weekend workshops, summer schools, craft sessions, yoga and studio hire.
clubs.address: Camargue House, 32 Wellington Lane, Cheltenham, GL52 2AG

clubs.name: ColourWheel Art Classes
clubs.description: Part-time adult courses for beginners and improvers, held on Wednesday mornings and afternoons at Cheltenham Cricket Club. Students work through drawing, colour mixing and painting in a variety of mediums, with all materials supplied and a free taster session available.
clubs.address: Cheltenham Cricket Club, Princes Street, Cheltenham, GL52 6BE

clubs.name: The Art Studio
clubs.description: Adult classes in drawing, painting, printing, mixed media and 3D work, held in a garden studio on weekday mornings and afternoons. Suitable for beginners and more experienced artists, with refreshments provided.
clubs.address: Charlton Kings, Cheltenham

clubs.name: Nature in Art
clubs.description: The world's first museum and gallery devoted to art inspired by nature, housed in a Georgian mansion just outside Gloucester, around 7 miles from Cheltenham.
clubs.address: Wallsworth Hall, Main A38, Twigworth, Gloucester, GL2 9PA

clubs.name: Wilson Art Gallery and Museum
clubs.description: Cheltenham's art gallery and museum, renamed The Wilson in 2013 in honour of polar explorer Edward Wilson, a son of Cheltenham.
clubs.address: Clarence Street, Cheltenham, GL50 3JT

clubs.name: Park Gallery
clubs.description: An independent contemporary gallery over three floors, showing wall art, sculpture, glass and ceramics by established and emerging artists.
clubs.address: 3 Montpellier Avenue, Cheltenham, GL50 1SA

clubs.name: Paragon Gallery
clubs.description: Exhibits and sells contemporary art and Modern Masters from local, UK and international artists.
clubs.address: 4 Rotunda Terrace, Montpellier Street, Cheltenham, GL50 1SW

clubs.name: The Gardens Gallery
clubs.description: Cheltenham's community art gallery in the Proscenium Building in Montpellier Gardens, opened in 2007. Local art groups and individual artists rent the space to exhibit, and entry is free.
clubs.address: Proscenium Building, Montpellier Gardens, Cheltenham

clubs.name: Spring Cheltenham
clubs.description: An art gallery hosting curated exhibitions and letting artists present their own shows, from paintings and sculpture to ceramics.
clubs.address: 14 Rotunda Terrace, Montpellier Street, Cheltenham, GL50 1SW

clubs.name: Sixteen Gallery
clubs.description: A contemporary art venue that artists can hire to run their own exhibitions, with an online platform for showcasing portfolios.
clubs.address: 16 Rotunda Terrace, Montpellier Street, Cheltenham, GL50 1SW

clubs.name: The Gloucestershire Guild Shop
clubs.description: A contemporary craft shop selling handmade jewellery, ceramics, textiles, furniture, leatherwork, glass and basketry.
